 Hinoki Onsen and Zen Morning Shower Mochi are back in stock in boxes of three and six.
I am thrilled to tell you that both are more aromatic than before. Zen Morning Shower Mochi
now has double the amount of Japanese Mint and Mexican lime. Hinoki Onsen Shower Mochi
has more entrancing Atlas cedanvood and a new addition- a touch of Haitian vetiver, giving it
a deep, rich base.
I am often asked "What does Shower Mochi do?"
Shower Mochi is about experience. By placing one of these aromatic tablets on your shower
floor, you are giving yourself time and space to breathe. This is about relaxation, mindfulness,
and emotional well-being. This experience is about going within and taking a break from the
day to day.
Use Shower Mochi When you have extra time. This is a ritual that can make a weekend
shower extraordinary, or help you wind down at the end of a busy day. Don't rush with this —
make it a special moment, just as you would a scented bath.
Take an extra few minuets to treat yourself to these Aromatic Experiences for the shower.
Shut your eyes, breathe deeply, and relax.
Warm wishes,
